grade.description: Overall verification result. PERFECT/VERIFIED pass through; PARTIAL/FEEDBACK feeds the correction back to the builder; FAILED escalates to a human.

feedback.description: Correction delivered to the builder verbatim. Empty when grade is PERFECT or VERIFIED. Lead with the single most important issue.

details.description: Long-form notes preserved for the verifier log: file:line references, command output, evidence.

commands_run.description: Verbatim commands the verifier ran. Helps humans reproduce.
